profile.description: Oman Education & Training Investment Company SAOG provides higher education services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company also provides technical and academic consulting; professional and academic training and qualification; and catering and maintenance services. In addition, it offers university and training services; cleaning, land scape, and pest control; and training services, vocational and administrative training institutes, as well as invests in funds and securities. Oman Education & Training Investment Company SAOG was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Sohar, the Sultanate of Oman.
